## History

Mrs. Spencer arranged the adoption transport that mistakenly brought [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead of a boy. To resolve the mix-up, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) drove [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to Mrs. Spencer's home, where they met with her to clarify the situation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P32](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER II. ## Relationships

### [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

Spencer is the parent of [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md). While they are related as parent and child, Spencer's home is primarily depicted as a site where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit to resolve an orphan mix-up. [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) is present within the family dynamic while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) decides whether to leave [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with another household or keep her.

- Parent of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004)</sub>
